message.content:
As of **November 2026**, the strongest comparable evidence is the **Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026**, supplemented by package-download and marketplace figures reported for late October/November. The ranking below prioritizes measured adoption; GitHub stars are included only where no stronger usage metric is available.

| Rank | Name | Type | Key usage metric | Source URL |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Claude Code** | CLI coding agent | **65.5%**, 8,030 respondents in Stack Overflow 2026; npm: **12,837,062 weekly downloads** for Oct. 22–28, 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent ; https://stackness.dev/blog/stack-overflow-developer-survey-2026-tool-changes-year-over-year |
| 2 | **GitHub Copilot agent** | IDE/cloud coding agent | **58.7%**, 7,196 respondents in Stack Overflow 2026; VS Code Copilot extensions: **79.3M installs** reported Nov. 14, 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent ; https://agentgid.com/lists/ai-coding-agents-for-vs-code/ |
| 3 | **OpenAI Codex CLI** | CLI coding agent | **29.5%**, 3,620 respondents; npm: **27,029,722 weekly downloads** for Oct. 22–28, 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent ; https://stackness.dev/blog/stack-overflow-developer-survey-2026-tool-changes-year-over-year |
| 4 | **Cursor** | IDE coding agent | **25.5%**, 3,127 respondents; JetBrains: **12%** workplace adoption in May–July 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent ; https://blog.jetbrains.com/research/2026/08/ai-coding-agent-adoption-2026/ |
| 5 | **Gemini Code Assist** | IDE coding agent | **14.6%**, 1,789 respondents in Stack Overflow 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent |
| 6 | **OpenCode** | Open-source CLI coding agent | **13.6%**, 1,662 respondents; npm: **4,458,157 weekly downloads** for Oct. 22–28, 2026; about **227K GitHub stars** reported Nov. 14 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent ; https://stackness.dev/blog/stack-overflow-developer-survey-2026-tool-changes-year-over-year ; https://agentgid.com/lists/ai-coding-agents-for-vs-code/ |
| 7 | **JetBrains AI** | IDE coding agent | **12.8%**, 1,569 respondents in Stack Overflow 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent |
| 8 | **Cline** | Open-source IDE coding agent | **4.5%**, 551 respondents; VS Code extension: **5.9M installs** reported Nov. 14, 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent ; https://agentgid.com/lists/open-source-coding-agents/ |
| 9 | **LangGraph** | Open-source agent framework/runtime | **18.8%**, 825 respondents in the Stack Overflow 2026 framework question | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data |
| 10 | **CrewAI** | Open-source agent framework/runtime | **5.5%**, 242 respondents in the Stack Overflow 2026 framework question | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data |
| 11 | **Aider** | Open-source CLI coding agent | **2.1%**, 256 respondents in Stack Overflow 2026 | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data/ai-code-agent |
| 12 | **Hermes Agent** | Open-source personal agent | **10.2%**, 449 respondents in the Stack Overflow 2026 framework/agent question | https://survey.stackoverflow.co/2026/ai/data |
| 13 | **Goose** | Open-source personal/desktop agent | **No verified usage number found** in the cited 2026 survey, package, marketplace, or company-user evidence | — |
| 14 | **OpenHands** | Open-source coding-agent runtime | **No verified usage number found** in the cited 2026 survey, package, marketplace, or company-user evidence | — |
| 15 | **nanobot (HKUDS)** | Open-source personal agent | **No verified usage number found** in the cited evidence | — |

### Additional requested projects

- **OpenClaw:** No hard usage number was found in the available evidence.
- **Gemini CLI:** No separate hard usage number was found; the **14.6%** figure above is for Gemini Code Assist, not necessarily Gemini CLI.
- **GitHub Copilot agent:** The Stack Overflow figure covers GitHub Copilot as a coding agent; it does not isolate the newer cloud coding-agent feature.
- **LangGraph and CrewAI:** Their Stack Overflow figures measure reported use of the framework category, not necessarily agents deployed in production.
- **Hermes Agent:** The survey provides a usage figure, but it should be treated cautiously because the cited results do not provide the full question wording or independent package-download validation.

The survey’s direct ranking for coding agents is therefore: **Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Google/Gemini tools, OpenCode, and JetBrains AI**. Stack Overflow reports Claude Code at **65.5%** and Copilot at **58.7%**, while JetBrains reports workplace adoption of Claude Code at **39%**, Copilot at **21%**, Codex at **16%**, and Cursor at **12%** for its May–July 2026 wave.[1][2]
